messages.author: 2e619edb395f310e
messages.subject: MSA plot alt coloring options
parts:
Hi,

I was wondering if there is a way to change the coloring in the msa plots so that each sequence is colored by gene rather than by base pair. I work with HIV, which can be rather different within and between participants. I think the easiest way would be if I could specify what proportion of the alignment I would like to contribute to a gene. For example, color the first 1% of the alignment blue to correspond to the LTR and the next 17% purple for the GAG gene. I realise that the best way would be to define gene breakpoints, but that is rather difficult with HIV's diversity. When we sequence full genomes, we see a lot of large deletions, and we would like to be able to communicate which genes those break points are in with colors. I have attached an example of what we would ideally like to be able to generate below. Alternatively, it would be good to be able to color the whole sequence by cell type similar to the colors I have filled the symbols with. Thank you for all of your great work on this package. Will hopefully be able to cite it in a new paper soon!

Thanks,
Kirston
